column3: Brigid can readjust your phantom weaponry attributes.
Do you seek to alter the attributes of your phantom weapon? A simple enough task, with sufficient resources.
Readjust the attributes of your phantom weaponry.
Learn about readjusting phantom weaponry attributes.
The three attributes you added to your phantom weaponry can be reselected or rebalanced. As with the initial augmentation, one of these attributes will be set to a lower value than the other two.
Once you have readjusted the values to your liking, select “Confirm” to finalize your decision.
Resetting your weaponry's attributes will require an additional chunk of ecliptic arcanite, so consider your choices carefully.
I require a single chunk of ecliptic arcanite to facilitate the readjustment. I shall leave its procurement in your capable hands.
Chunks of ecliptic arcanite can be obtained from Ermina in the phantom village.
I'm afraid the process is tailored specifically to phantom weaponry. Might I ask you to equip suitable armaments before beginning?
A thoroughly successful readjustment! Of course, if you wish to explore a subtly different configuration in the future, you need but ask.
Your phantom weaponry () has been readjusted.
